report.previous_run_delta: New: Vercel launched Grok 4.7 with automatic 40% promotional pricing through September 27; unpaid AI Gateway accounts receive $5 of credits every 30 days, allowing a zero-cash coding-agent benchmark. Strengthening: Cloudflare added a dashboard invitation flow for the per-Worker roles reported September 15. Excluded: Vercel Connect for Microsoft Teams requires a tenant administrator and Azure subscription and has no verified free allowance. No new Devin-class program cleared verification.
program_surface_results: No new startup, founder, builder, accelerator, partner-benefit, grant, hackathon, or research-preview program suitable for the bootstrapped solo-builder profile survived primary-source verification.
The 60–90 day magnitude lookback found no exceptional still-actionable program absent from the existing ledger.

The Devin benchmark detector now covers vendor grant pages, partner navigation, model-promotion catalogs, cohort deadlines, footer-linked programs, and API release notes; the remaining weakness is discovery of non-indexed authenticated partner benefits.

signals.classification: CONFIRMED FRESH MODEL / TEMPORARY PRICING / ZERO-CASH TEST
signals.changed: Grok 4.7 launched on Vercel AI Gateway, fx, and eve on September 21 with a 500,000-token context window, low through xhigh reasoning, image input, tool calling, and direct compatibility with Codex and other coding agents. Promotional pricing is automatic through September 27.
signals.free_value: Vercel states that AI Gateway users who have never made a payment receive $5 of credits every 30 days. At the promotional rates, $5 covers about 4.17 million input tokens if spent only on input, 1.39 million output tokens if spent only on output, or a smaller mixed workload. The promotion itself is a discount, not an extra credit grant.
signals.approximate_value: $5 of recurring gateway credit for an unpaid account; the seven-day discount increases its purchasing power by 66.7% versus the model's stated normal $2/M input and $6/M output pricing. This is validation capacity, not production-scale subsidy.
signals.cash_required: $0 if the account still qualifies for the unpaid-user credit and the benchmark stays within the displayed balance. Otherwise usage is metered at $1.20/M input and $3.60/M output tokens through September 27, plus $0.30/M cache reads and $5/1,000 web-search calls when used.
signals.eligibility_reality_check: No startup, funding, incorporation, geography, domain-email, partner, team-size, or application gate is published. A Vercel AI Gateway account and API key are required. The $5 allowance is expressly for users who have not made a payment; prior payment may disqualify the account. A card requirement for the unpaid allowance is not stated on the model page. Model use is subject to SpaceXAI terms and privacy policies.
signals.why_asymmetric: The same model ID works in the AI SDK, OpenAI-compatible APIs, eve, fx, Codex, Cursor, Amp, and OpenCode, so one free-credit evaluation can test coding, long-context retrieval, tool use, and self-verification without new orchestration work.

evidence.confirmed_fact: Vercel publishes the September 21 release, 500K context, reasoning controls, $1.20/$3.60 promotional rates, September 27 end date, coding-agent setup, ZDR and no-training routing controls, and the $5-per-30-days unpaid-user credit.
evidence.inference: A fixed evaluation suite can determine whether Grok 4.7 replaces more expensive calls or adds a useful independent verifier for B₂ROOT and LEVERAGEδ.
evidence.unverified_claim: No independent quality, latency, or tool-reliability benchmark was run, and the actual account credit balance was not observed.

signals.catch: The headline 40% discount is not free production capacity and expires after one week. The $5 credit is account-state dependent. Reasoning tokens count toward output usage, web search is separately expensive, and the model has only one listed provider, limiting failover diversity.
signals.window: Promotional pricing ends September 27, 2026. Vercel states that the unpaid-user credit refreshes every 30 days but does not state a program end date on the model page.
signals.immediate_exploit: Run one existing 10–20-case coding-agent or evidence-verification suite with web search disabled, xhigh reasoning used only on the hardest cases, and a $5 gateway budget. Compare pass rate, tool correctness, latency, input/output tokens, and cost against the current baseline; stop if the account shows no free balance.

omissions_errors: The account-specific $5 balance, payment history, card requirement, and hard-stop behavior were unobservable.
No new bootstrapped-accessible magnitude program survived primary-source verification.
Vercel Connect for Microsoft Teams was excluded because it requires tenant-admin setup and an Azure subscription, and no zero-cost allowance was established.
Cloudflare's dashboard invitation flow was treated as a strengthening update to the already-ledgered per-Worker permission signal, not a recycled signal.
